The surface derivation algebra

Reference·seedling·proposed·JUL 10, 2026

The reference for phase 1's derivation layer: the exhaustive reflex→surface mapping, the shipping combinators (observableSource · pollSource · scanCell · foldCollection · scanStream · registryFromFamily · pollCollection + CollectionSpec.equals) with their wire semantics, the five constraints every deriver obeys, the error doctrine's statefulness line, what each shipping item subsumes (file:line), the deferred set with named triggers, the N/A arguments (switching, cross-channel combines), and the open questions.

This is the reference for the derivation algebra that ships in W5’s phase-1 surface refactor — the layer that makes a derived member a declaration instead of a hand-wired publish. The teaching companion is the attention primer; this note is for precision: the full reflex→surface mapping, the shipping signatures with wire semantics, and the arguments for everything deliberately absent. Ground trees for every file:line cite: kolu origin/master, drishti master.

Two words the whole note leans on. A tick is one producer microtask flush — the surface analog of a reflex frame (precedent: createTickCoalescer, packages/surface/src/server.ts:281-312). Each deriving combinator owns its own flush — it never presumes a sibling coalescer exists. And the wire has no shared frame: each member travels its own channel with its own latency, which is the single fact behind most of the N/A verdicts below.

The five constraints

Every combinator in the algebra obeys these; they are the design, not guidelines.

  1. One writer. Every deriver is a same-process projection; a derived member is wire-read-only, enforced by a boot check (below).
  2. Dedup lives solely at the target member’s spec gate — cell spec equals (server.ts:198-207, 1469-1474) or collection spec equals (phase 1). No deriver carries a second, invisible gate; pollSource and pollCollection deliberately have none of their own.
  3. Snapshot-then-delta. Every derived member’s reconnect story is the framework’s own: cell store replay; subscribeBeforeSnapshot for scan streams (server.ts:350-363); the collection deltas snapshot.
  4. Mirrors never fabricate. Folds seed from actual current truth; only push-source holds use the declared default, which belongs to the one writer (the primer’s phase 1).
  5. Fail-fast, with the statefulness line — the error doctrine, next section.

The error doctrine — the statefulness line

Where a deriver fails determines what honesty permits:

  • A sync in-tick fold (foldCollection) that throws escapes the flush and crashes the process — a producer-context defect, the repo’s fail-fast rule applied literally.
  • An async stateless pump (deriveCell, observableSource+deriveCell, registryFromFamily’s resolve, pollCollection’s per-tick read) logs a per-frame failure via onError (default stderr — never invisible) and keeps consuming, holding the last published value: each frame is independent, so the next frame self-heals. This is framework law, in one place, for what previously needed a per-site catch.
  • An async stateful pump (scanCell, scanStream) whose step throws routes to onError and stops, holding last state: carried state missed a frame, so every subsequent fold would derive from corrupted state — continuing would fabricate.

Neither path swallows or collapses to a default. deriveCell (packages/surface/src/project.ts:236-280) accordingly distinguishes its two failure surfaces: pump death (upstream rejects, or the iterable throws/ends) → onError, loop ends holding last value — a dead iterator cannot be consumed further; per-frame failure (the map or the cell set throws) → onError, frame skipped, loop continues. Whether a stopped stateful pump should escalate beyond stderr — e.g. flip the member’s liveness gate so the freeze shows on health() — is open question 7.

The shipping subset (phase 1)

The boot checks (ship with foldCollection)

(a) One writer. implementSurface rejects, at wiring time, any derived member (foldCollection / scanCell / deriveCell / pollCollection / registryFromFamily target) whose resolved verbs (resolveCellVerbs define.ts:206 / resolveCollectionVerbs define.ts:223) include a mutation verb: set, patch, upsert, delete, or test__set (define.ts:54, contract entry define.ts:260-261 — a wire mutation like any other). A derivation is the fact’s one writer; tests reset a derived member by writing its source. Cells that are not derivation targets are exempt: padi’s session cell (surface.ts:595-599, verbs ["get","test__set"]) keeps its named imperative writers and its test__set — it is an ordinary cell, argued out of the algebra below (“not subsumed”).

(b) No declared cycles. The from-declared sibling-reference graph (foldCollection / combineCells / gateEvent / scanCollection) is walked at wiring; a cycle is a boot error. Free-form upstream functions (scanCell over an arbitrary iterable) are invisible to this walk; for those the documented semantics are equals-gated fixpoint termination — every hop publishes through its target’s equals gate, so a value-converging loop quiesces, and a non-converging loop is a declared-graph bug (livelock), not a framework hazard. The rule’s reach is open question 10.

observableSource / pollSource — the source-kind adapters

/** Adapt a callback/push observable into the ONE upstream shape every
 *  deriver accepts (UpstreamSource, project.ts:109-112). `install` runs
 *  once per subscription; uninstall on abort. NO snapshot synthesized — a
 *  push-only source's first frame arrives when the source speaks; until
 *  then a derived cell holds its `initial` (the one writer's declared
 *  default). */
export function observableSource<F>(
  install: (emit: (frame: F) => void) => () => void,
): (opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }) => Promise<AsyncIterable<F>>;

/** Poll-on-event upstream for CELL-shaped derivations — the cell twin of
 *  the stream {read, install} deps (server.ts:1171-1199), REUSING
 *  pollOnEvent's scheduling (server.ts:540-561). First frame = read() (a
 *  genuine snapshot); then re-read per event tick. NO isEqual — dedup is
 *  the target cell's spec `equals`, the algebra's one gate (pollOnEvent's
 *  stream-side isEqual exists only because streams HAVE no spec gate).
 *  `onReadError` default = stderr; initial-read errors always propagate
 *  (no snapshot yet ⇒ nothing honest to serve); later read failures follow
 *  the stateless-pump rule: log, skip, keep polling. */
export function pollSource<F>(opts: {
  read: () => Promise<F>;
  install: (onEvent: () => void) => () => void;
  onReadError?: (err: unknown) => void;
}): (opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }) => Promise<AsyncIterable<F>>;

scanCell — stateful fold into a cell

/** Fold an upstream's frames through carried state into a cell. Rides the
 *  cell `connect` seam (server.ts:1120, fired at 1493-1494); every step
 *  result flows through equals/onWrite/store.set/bus.publish — dedup is
 *  the target cell's spec equals, nothing else. accumMaybe semantics:
 *  return the previous state reference to publish nothing.
 *
 *  DURABILITY: the pump seeds carried state from `opts.store` when given.
 *  The store is a constructor argument, not a widened runtime seam: the
 *  deriver constructs and returns the deps INCLUDING the store (a
 *  construction-time fact), and CellStore.get() is synchronous
 *  (server.ts:77-80), so the seed happens at wiring with no window in
 *  which the pump folds over a default and a late read clobbers it.
 *  servePadi passes its Conf-backed activityFeed store
 *  (servePadi.ts:213-218) here; a restart resumes the MRU instead of
 *  clobbering it on first fold. A scan whose state must NOT survive
 *  restarts passes no store — the choice is visible in the declaration.
 *
 *  Error policy (statefulness line): a throwing `step` → onError (default
 *  stderr) + pump STOPS holding last state; pump death → same. Abort-shaped
 *  rejections swallowed (isAbortReason, server.ts:1060).
 *
 *  Demand: drishti's alerts hysteresis scan is a committed simultaneous
 *  consumer — both W5 phases ship as one campaign under the paired-PR rule
 *  (.claude/rules/surface.md) — and scanStream + deriveCell are
 *  implemented on this one loop (one teardown/abort/error home).
 *  deriveCell(u, map, i) ≡ scanCell(u, (_s, f) => map(f), i) — with the
 *  stateless specialization keeping the continue-on-frame-error policy. */
export function scanCell<F, S>(
  upstream: (opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }) => Promise<AsyncIterable<F>>,
  step: (state: S, frame: F) => S,
  initial: S | ((stored: S | undefined) => S), // stored = opts.store?.get()
  opts?: { store?: CellStore<S>; onError?: (err: unknown) => void },
): DerivedCellDeps<S> & { dispose: () => void };

foldCollection — collection→cell fold (the headline)

/** Declare a cell as a STATELESS fold of a sibling collection in the SAME
 *  implementSurface deps. Wire semantics:
 *  - SEED: fold(readAll()) at wiring — current truth, never a default.
 *  - TRIGGER: foldCollection OWNS ITS OWN microtask flush (same shape as
 *    createTickCoalescer, server.ts:281-312), armed by the collection's
 *    WRAPPED upsert/remove (server.ts:1585-1600). It does NOT share the
 *    deltas coalescer: that coalescer exists only when the collection opts
 *    into `deltas` (server.ts:1526-1542, collectionHasDeltas
 *    define.ts:229-235), and the headline consumer's terminals collection
 *    declares verbs ["keys","get"] (padi surface.ts:606) — no deltas, no
 *    coalescer. Every write seam — including removals — arms the fold
 *    structurally; "no seam decides" stops being prose.
 *  - PUBLISH: through the cell's equals/onWrite/store.set/bus.publish
 *    path; dedup at the cell's spec equals (urgencyEqual stays).
 *  - RECONNECT: an ordinary cell — store snapshot then deltas.
 *  - FAIL-FAST: a throwing fold escapes the flush and crashes the process.
 *  - ONE WRITER: the boot check rejects mutation verbs incl. test__set.
 *  `from` is boot-checked; unknown sibling key throws at wiring. */
export function foldCollection<K, T, V>(opts: {
  from: string; // sibling collection key in the same spec
  fold: (entries: ReadonlyMap<K, T>) => V;
}): DerivedCellDeps<V>;

scanStream + scanMsgSchema — stateful scan with a snapshot-then-delta face

export type ScanMsg<S, D> =
  | { kind: "snapshot"; state: S }
  | { kind: "delta"; delta: D };
/** One wire authority for the scan frame — the stream twin of
 *  collectionDeltasSchema (define.ts:274-287). */
export function scanMsgSchema<S, D>(
  state: ZodType<S>, delta: ZodType<D>,
): ZodType<ScanMsg<S, D>>;
/** ONE process-lifetime pump owns the state: step(state, frame) →
 *  {state, delta}; each delta publishes on an internal channel. EACH wire
 *  subscriber gets subscribeBeforeSnapshot(bus, signal, () => [{kind:
 *  "snapshot", state}]) (server.ts:350-363) — subscribe-BEFORE-snapshot
 *  closes the lost-update window a hand-rolled snapshot-first pump has
 *  (a delta born in the gap is lost until reconnect). Fail-fast: step
 *  throw → onError + pump stops holding state (stateful rule);
 *  subscribers see silence, never fabricated frames. Dedup: none by
 *  design (a time series appends). Consumers: drishti's metric-history
 *  ring, including the W5 alerts campaign's ring. */
export function scanStream<F, S, D>(opts: {
  upstream: (o: { signal?: AbortSignal }) => Promise<AsyncIterable<F>>;
  step: (state: S, frame: F) => { state: S; delta: D };
  initial: S;
  onError?: (err: unknown) => void;
}): StreamHandlerDeps<void, ScanMsg<S, D>> & { dispose: () => void };

The collection connect seam + registryFromFamily — keyed families

/** CollectionImplDeps gains the cell-symmetric republish seam (cell
 *  precedent: server.ts:1120, fired at 1493-1494): the runtime hands the
 *  WRAPPED publishers (server.ts:1585-1600) once after wiring. Ships in
 *  phase 1 because pollCollection requires it at deps-construction time;
 *  collectionFromFamily (deferred) rides it when triggered. */
connect?: (coll: { upsert: (key: K, value: T) => void; remove: (key: K) => void }) => void;

/** The keyed-family core — hold each key's last frame, reconcile
 *  attaches/detaches on membership change, project purely, per-member
 *  error isolation — shipped behind the face its ONE live consumer feeds:
 *  a pull-shaped MapRegistry (members/has/subscribe/resolve) consumed by
 *  serveSurfaceMap (serveHostMap.ts:238+ builds MapRegistry directly,
 *  resolve → entry + link). The links cache (serveHostMap.ts:147) is IN
 *  the contract: a resolve-time lazy memo per member, evicted on exit.
 *  Semantics: the framework HOLDS each key's last frame (the latestState
 *  Map, serveHostMap.ts:145); RECONCILES subs on each membership emit;
 *  an entry with NO frame yet resolves project(key, undefined) — the
 *  projection owns the honest "not yet" arm (projectState's undefined →
 *  connecting, serveHostMap.ts:52-77); a throwing project/onChange routes
 *  to onError (default stderr) and keeps the last resolved value — one
 *  member's failure never freezes siblings, never invisibly. */
export function registryFromFamily<K, F, Entry, Link>(opts: {
  members: {
    list: () => readonly K[];
    has: (k: K) => boolean;
    subscribe: (onChange: () => void) => () => void; // fires after list/has reflect the change
  };
  attach: (key: K, emit: (frame: F) => void) => () => void;
  resolve: (key: K, last: F | undefined) => Entry;   // pure projection
  linkFor?: (key: K) => Link;                        // resolve-time memo; evicted on exit
  onError?: (key: K, err: unknown) => void;
}): MapRegistry<K, Entry, Link> & { dispose: () => void };

pollCollection + CollectionSpec.equals — the poll→keyed-map reconcile

/** Poll a keyed external source, diff against the served snapshot, upsert
 *  changed keys, evict vanished ones — through the wrapped publishers (the
 *  collection connect seam), so per-key subscribers, keysBus membership
 *  dedup (broadcastKeys, server.ts:1584) and, where the `deltas` verb is
 *  declared, the tick coalescer all fire from ONE declaration.
 *
 *  Wire semantics per tick:
 *  - read() → next: ReadonlyMap<K,T>.
 *  - For each [k, v] in next: publish upsert(k, v) — the per-key gate is
 *    the TARGET COLLECTION's spec `equals`; pollCollection carries NO
 *    equality predicate of its own (the diff's equality IS the member's
 *    declared equals, one visible gate). With no equals declared the gate
 *    defaults to Object.is per key — freshly-allocated equal values
 *    republish, which is the honest default (drishti's networkInterfaces
 *    deliberately upserts unconditionally) and the incentive to declare
 *    equals (drishti's processes declares its MUTABLE_PROCESS_FIELDS-based
 *    predicate as the spec equals in the paired PR).
 *  - For each served key not in next: remove(k). remove-then-upsert-equal
 *    within one tick still publishes (membership changed; last-op-wins
 *    pending map, server.ts:284-311).
 *  - Deltas verb declared ⇒ one coalesced {upserts,removes} frame per
 *    tick, subscribe-before-snapshot on the framework path.
 *  - First tick runs immediately (populate within one scan); read failure
 *    after the first successful tick follows the stateless-pump rule (log
 *    via onReadError, skip tick, keep polling); a failing FIRST read
 *    propagates (nothing honest to serve).
 *
 *  Demand: the most-repeated hand-roll in both trees — three production
 *  instances in one drishti function (agent main.ts:262-330) and four
 *  documentation instances (fleet-top ×3, remote-process-monitor) that
 *  teach users to hand-roll exactly this. */
export function pollCollection<K, T>(opts: {
  read: () => Promise<ReadonlyMap<K, T>>;
  install: (onTick: () => void) => () => void; // cadence owner: interval, event, or both
  onReadError?: (err: unknown) => void;
}): CollectionFamilyDeps<K, T> & { dispose: () => void };

// CollectionSpec.equals — ships with pollCollection (live demand:
// drishti's processChanged, agent main.ts:90-106):
interface CollectionSpec<K, T> { equals?: (a: T, b: T) => boolean }
// Gates the wrapped upsert's per-key publish AND coalescer enqueue
// (server.ts:1585-1600), mirroring the cell gate (server.ts:198-207).
// remove-then-upsert-equal within one tick still publishes (membership
// changed; the last-op-wins pending map already models this).

What each shipping item subsumes

Each shipping addition deletes a named hand-roll (kolu paths repo-relative to kolu master; drishti paths to drishti master):

  1. foldCollection ← padi urgency (the headline). packages/padi/src/urgency.ts:23-38 (recomputeUrgency) becomes the fold; the wiring dies. packages/padi/src/terminalEndpoint/metadata.ts:110-112 (publishUrgency) + its call inside publishComposedTerminal (:104): deleted — the recompute rides foldCollection’s own flush armed by the wrapped upsert/remove. metadata.ts:129-132 (the removal-path refold): deleted — removes arm the same flush. The prose invariant at metadata.ts:28-35 retires — it becomes structure. servePadi.ts:180’s seed becomes fold(readAll()); equals: urgencyEqual (servePadi.ts:179-182, urgency.ts:44-50) stays on the spec — the one dedup point.
  2. observableSource + pollSource + deriveCell ← the callback-source hand-wires. packages/server/src/index.ts:842-853 (padiSession.onState → padiLink + processStartedAt) becomes two derived cells over one observableSource((emit) => padiSession.onState(emit)); mapConnectionToPadiLink (padiLink.ts:37-49) survives as the map. packages/surface-remote/src/connectionPipe.ts:36-64 (pipeSessionStateToCell + projectConnection, live via hostFanout.ts:191) becomes deriveCell(observableSource(...), projectConnection, DEFAULT_CONNECTION); projectConnection survives as the map and seedConnectionCell stays (a seeded store is legitimate deps); its catch-and-keep-consuming (connectionPipe.ts:53-63) is not deleted but promoted — it is deriveCell’s per-frame policy, one law where three spellings lived. pollSource sites, four: index.ts:881 (daemonInventory sampler), index.ts:797-810 (the kolu-server processMemory sampler — precisely the {read, install} shape), packages/padi/src/hostInventory.ts:331, packages/padi/src/memorySampler.ts:61. None grows a local isEqual — dedup at each target cell’s spec equals.
  3. scanCell ← drishti’s alerts scan (committed) + conditionally padi’s activityFeed. Primary: the W5 alerts hysteresis scan — same campaign, paired-PR rule, so the consumer exists at ship time by construction. Conditional: padi activity.ts:73-101 — only if trackRecentRepo/trackRecentAgent become emitter publishes (open question 5); what scanCell buys there is one-writer structure (the functions are synchronous — there is no race to fix). Independent of that timing: the read-path back-write (activity.ts:50-57 — a getter that filters and writes back) is a second writer by another name, fixed regardless. Durability is real: the Conf-backed store (servePadi.ts:213-218) passes as opts.store; a restart resumes the MRU.
  4. scanStream + scanMsgSchema ← drishti’s metric history. router.ts:241-245 (recordSample) becomes the step; pushSample (common/history.ts:94-103) survives as pure logic. router.ts:108-117 (hand historyRing + historyBus): owned by the pump. router.ts:198-208 (hand snapshot-then-delta, snapshot-before-subscribe): deleted — subscribeBeforeSnapshot closes the lost-update window. router.ts:279-289 (the pump sink fusing system.set + recordSample at the write site): the fusion dies — the scan subscribes the system cell’s own publish path.
  5. registryFromFamily ← serveHostMap’s session family. serveHostMap.ts:145 (latestState cache): framework-held. :150 (fused fire) + :161-185 (attach: cache-then-fire, the per-member catch): the attach/onError contract. :193-206 (membership reconcile): framework reconcile. :147 (the links cache) with its lazy memo and detach-time eviction: in the contract as linkFor. projectState (:52-77) survives as the one resolve projection (the undefined → connecting arm intact), with causeFor enrichment (:109-113) composed inside it. drishti’s packages/app/src/server/hostMapRegistry.ts (a hand-adapted clone; clockOffset hardcoded 0): deleted — drishti declares registryFromFamily and imports the shared projection, collapsing the two-authorities drift (the projection takes last: F | undefined, clock handling composed in the resolve fn).
  6. The collection connect seam ships with pollCollection (its unconditional demand). Whether padi’s registry exposes one onChange that collapses the five publishComposedTerminal write seams (metadata.ts:142-171, 182-213, 221-229, 245-248, 120-122) through composePadiTerminal (metadata.ts:73-81 survives as the map) is open question 6; if declined, that convention stays and only its urgency rider (item 1) is deleted.
  7. pollCollection + CollectionSpec.equals ← the poll→keyed-map reconciles. drishti agent main.ts:262-330: the tick’s three hand reconciles (processes with hand-dedup + hand delta bus; cpuCores with evict; networkInterfaces with evict) become three pollCollection declarations sharing one read cadence. main.ts:90-106 (MUTABLE_PROCESS_FIELDS + processChanged): becomes the processes collection’s spec equals — the hand-held per-key dedup moves to the algebra’s one gate. main.ts:211-221 (the processesSnapshot stream: yield snapshot, then subscribe the hand delta bus — a snapshot-before-subscribe window) + main.ts:295 (fused delta publish): deleted — the collection already declares the deltas verb (common/surface.ts:249); the framework coalescer serves the same wire shape with subscribe-before-snapshot. Paired-PR consequence: drishti’s agent-written collections currently expose wire upsert/delete (common/surface.ts:249, 258); as pollCollection targets, the boot check rejects those verbs — the paired PR narrows them to ["keys","get","deltas"], making the one-writer fact wire-true for drishti too. kolu’s doc-tree examples rewrite on the same combinator: fleet-top parts 1–3 (src/server/top.ts:91-102, src/daemon/top.ts:93-96, src/agent/top.ts:93-96) and remote-process-monitor (src/agent/main.ts:167-187).

Not subsumed, deliberately:

  • padi session autosave (packages/padi/src/session.ts:19-65, driven by the AutosaveGate off terminals:dirty): argued out of the algebra. It resembles the fold shape, but the session cell has multiple legitimate writers — restore’s clear, restart’s capture, the autosave fold, and the wire test__set (surface.ts:595-599) — because “what the saved session is” is genuinely decided by more than one actor. A fold declaration would be a lie the boot check turns into a boot failure; session is not a derivation target, so the one-writer check does not apply and its test__set stays legal.
  • remotePadiBinding.ts:721-740 (base.onState mutating module-local convergence/clockOffset state): a scan-shaped hold, but its outputs feed the pull-shaped PadiSession accessor facade (convergence(), clockOffset() closures), not a surface member. The algebra’s combinators target surface members; this becomes scanCell demand if convergence is ever served as a member.
  • padi daemonStatus chain (daemonStatus.ts:76 upsert): already the wrapped-path collection publish — framework-shaped today.
  • kaval’s PTY-attach protocol (packages/kaval/src/inProcessPtyHost.ts:138, 232): a snapshot-then-delta discipline on kaval’s own attach API — not a surface member; out of scope.
  • surface-map’s client-side floorOnLiveness/foldState/scopedByEntry (client.ts:93-125, 530-543; scoped.ts:81-210): correct client-policy homes (Solid memo dedup, no wire involvement); makeEntryClock (client.ts:132-140) is a pure lens.

Deferred — cataloged, trigger named

// collectionFromFamily — the collection-member face of the keyed-family
// core (population-zero as a collection member today: serveHostMap feeds a
// MapRegistry, not a collection member). Trigger: surface-map's serving
// seam reworked to consume a collection member (or any first keyed
// push-family served as one). Shares registryFromFamily's
// hold/reconcile/project core; adds the wrapped upsert/remove publish leg
// via the collection connect seam.
export function collectionFromFamily<K, F, T>(opts: {
  members: (emit: (keys: readonly K[]) => void) => () => void;
  attach: (key: K, emit: (frame: F) => void) => () => void;
  project: (key: K, last: F | undefined) => T;
  onError?: (key: K, err: unknown) => void;
}): CollectionFamilyDeps<K, T> & { dispose: () => void };

// deriveCollection — the missing Incremental fmap (cross-surface,
// patch-preserving). Trigger: first projectSurface exposing a collection
// member (MCP mirror / narrowed peer view).
export function deriveCollection<K, F, T>(
  upstream: (o: { signal?: AbortSignal }) => Promise<AsyncIterable<CollectionDeltasMsg<K, F>>>,
  mapValue: (key: K, value: F) => T, // KEY-PRESERVING; key remap = move/collision semantics, out of scope
  opts?: { onError?: (err: unknown) => void },
): CollectionFamilyDeps<K, T> & { dispose: () => void };
// Wire semantics: an upstream delta of n keys maps to a downstream delta of
// ≤n keys — never a refold. An upstream snapshot (reconnect) is DIFFED
// against currently-served entries; the equality used is the TARGET
// member's declared CollectionSpec.equals — a HARD dependency. Absent a
// declared equals the diff falls back to Object.is per key, which re-emits
// every freshly-decoded entry on reconnect — i.e. patch-preservation
// across reconnects is only as good as the declared equals, stated rather
// than hidden. No invisible deep-equal is ever embedded.

// combineCells — same-process zip (reflex zipDynWith / pull / attach).
// Trigger: first derived member reading two sibling sources.
export function combineCells<A, B, V>(opts: {
  from: [string, string]; // sibling cell keys, boot-checked (incl. the cycle rule)
  combine: (a: A, b: B) => V;
}): DerivedCellDeps<V>;
// Seed = combine(storeA.get(), storeB.get()) at wiring. Recompute coalesced
// per microtask tick on ITS OWN flush (coalescer shape, server.ts:281-312):
// two same-tick source writes publish ONE combined frame. SAME-PROCESS
// ONLY; cross-surface zip deliberately absent (no transactional frame on
// the wire) — client-side pairing is the honest tick.

// Event filtering — fmapMaybe/ffilter for events ONLY.
// Trigger: first projection narrowing an event feed.
export const SKIP: unique symbol;
export function deriveEvent<I, F, T>(
  upstream: UpstreamSource<I, F>,
  map: (frame: F) => T | typeof SKIP,
): EventHandlerDeps<I, T>;
// Legal: events carry no snapshot obligation (project.ts:172-179).
// Streams: NOT offered — dropping the first frame breaks snapshot-then-
// delta reconnect (define.ts:58-63); hold-last-passing-value is scanCell.

// gateEvent — reflex `gate`. Trigger: with SKIP, first sibling-gated feed.
export function gateEvent<I, F, C>(opts: {
  upstream: UpstreamSource<I, F>;
  from: string; // sibling cell key (cycle-rule participant)
  when: (current: C) => boolean; // reads the post-write store at frame time
}): EventHandlerDeps<I, F>;

// scanCollection — stateful/incremental fold over collection changes
// (reflex accumIncremental). Trigger: a foldCollection measured too hot at
// full refold over large N (urgency today is a deliberate, cheap full
// refold, urgency.ts:23-38).
export function scanCollection<K, T, S>(opts: {
  from: string;
  step: (state: S, change: CollectionDelta<K, T>) => S;
  initial: (entries: ReadonlyMap<K, T>) => S; // seed from truth
}): DerivedCellDeps<S>;

// mergeSources — interleave N upstreams into one event member (reflex
// merge/leftmost/mergeWith, collapsed — no cross-channel simultaneity).
// Trigger: first N-source event member.
export function mergeSources<I, F>(
  ...sources: UpstreamSource<I, F>[]
): UpstreamSource<I, F>;

Not applicable — the arguments

Switching (switch, switchHold*, coincidence, Dynamic-join) — N/A on the wire. (1) A switching occurrence must carry an Event as its value; a wire frame is Zod-schema’d data (define.ts:245-265) and a live channel is process-bound state. (2) The only serializable stand-in is a channel handle — a capability crossing the serialization boundary: dead epochs after reconnect, an undefinable snapshot obligation, a second writer on “which stream is current”. (3) The promptly trichotomy is a same-frame timing distinction, and per-member channels have no shared frame. What survives is first-order: the switching index travels as data — a collection key (a per-key get held open on an absent key is switchHold never’s idle state, server.ts:382-417) — and the client re-subscribes on index change; client-side scopedByEntry (scoped.ts:81-210) is the switching machinery. The unkeyed Dynamic join collapses to the same encoding: the outer value is data (an index), the client re-subscribes.

Cross-channel combines (Event Align/Zip/Apply instances, difference, wire-level zipDyn, attach-over-the-wire) — N/A. All are defined by same-frame simultaneity, and per-member wire channels share no frame: intersection is meaningless, every union collapses to plain interleave (mergeSources, deferred), and “the Behavior’s value at the occurrence” is undefined when the two frames ride independent channels with independent latencies. Server-side, same-process, the combine is legal and is combineCells (deferred); client-side, the pairing lives in the UI’s reactive batch (a Solid memo). The same no-shared-frame fact settles the tagPromptlyDyn family: surface folds always see the post-write value (store.set precedes bus.publish, server.ts:198-207), so derivation semantics are uniformly “promptly” — and there is no same-frame old-value/new-value distinction left to spell.

The monad, the graph, the sugar. PushM/PullM: the server process is the monad — handlers are arbitrary TS that read stores synchronously and hold state; reifying it adds nothing. The *Cheap variants: a Haskell pull-graph performance contract with no analog (a surface bus is already multicast). Query/crop/SelectedCount: per-member subscription + AbortSignal is a query declaration; subscriber counts are SelectedCount; abort is the decrement-to-zero prune — a genuine analog becomes worth building at range/viewport partial subscription over a large collection. maybeDyn/eitherDyn/factorDyn/demux: client-side discriminated rendering (a memo on the discriminant; Solid <Show>/<Switch> are the inner factoring).

The mapping, exhaustively

Legend: EXISTS (file:line, verified in-tree) · ADD-SHIP (ships phase 1, demand named) · ADD-DEFER (cataloged above, trigger named) · N/A (argued). File cites are kolu packages/surface/src/… unless another package is named.

reflex combinator / family verdict surface analog
§0 primitives
Behavior EXISTS stream member (define.ts:152-155): derived, read-only, sampled at will. Server-side, any sibling cell’s current value is also a Behavior: deps.store.get() read synchronously (server.ts:198-207).
Event EXISTS event member (define.ts:157-160): occurrence, no snapshot obligation (project.ts:172-179).
Dynamic EXISTS + phase 1 cell (define.ts:89-144) is the value half; the change half is phase 1’s updated() on the client Subscription, change-iff-fired enforced at the producer by spec equals (server.ts:198-207).
Incremental EXISTS collection with the opt-in deltas verb (define.ts:64-87): snapshot = PatchTarget, coalesced upserts/removes = the patch; one wire authority collectionDeltasSchema (define.ts:274-287).
currentIncremental EXISTS the collection’s snapshot half: server readAll() / client per-key get + keys — the current PatchTarget without the patch stream.
updatedIncremental EXISTS the deltas verb’s delta frames alone — the patch stream without the snapshot (a client that skips frame 1).
incrementalToDynamic EXISTS snapshot + client-side fold of deltas into a whole-map view — what the deltas verb’s client consumer does (surface-map’s folded entry collection decodes the same one authority).
PushM / PullM N/A the server process is the monad — handlers are arbitrary TS reading stores synchronously.
never EXISTS an event member nobody publishes.
constant EXISTS a cell default with no writer; inMemoryCell(initial) (project.ts:242).
push / pushAlways / pushCheap EXISTS / ADD-DEFER always-firing map = deriveEvent (project.ts:180-187); the Maybe-filtering half is the deferred SKIP return. Cheap variants N/A (graph-caching contract; a surface bus is already multicast).
pull ADD-DEFER server / EXISTS client server-side multi-cell recompute = combineCells (deferred); client-side, a Solid memo over useCell subscriptions already is pull.
switch, coincidence N/A see the switching argument above.
current / updated EXISTS / phase 1 the client accessor half exists today; updated() change pairs are phase 1.
unsafeBuildDynamic / unsafeBuildIncremental EXISTS the raw source escape hatch (StreamImplDeps raw branch, server.ts:1171-1199): the author vouches for snapshot-then-delta — reflex’s “caller owns the law” posture.
mergeIncrementalG / …WithMoveG ADD-DEFER collectionFromFamily — keyed sources joining/leaving under a membership reconcile, as a collection member. The live keyed-family consumer feeds a pull-shaped MapRegistry instead — that face ships as registryFromFamily. Trigger for the collection face: surface-map’s serving seam consuming a collection member.
behaviorCoercion etc. N/A TS structural typing makes coercions free.
sample (MonadSample) EXISTS synchronous store.get() / ctx cells.<k>.get() (server.ts:1469-1474); app-level use: activity.ts:73-101.
hold / holdDyn ADD-SHIP observableSource + deriveCell: hold a push source’s last frame in a cell (subsumes item 2).
holdIncremental EXISTS the collection store + wrapped upsert/remove publish path (server.ts:1585-1600).
poll → keyed snapshot reconcile ADD-SHIP pollCollection — the Incremental twin of pollSource; no single reflex name. The most-repeated hand-roll in both trees (subsumes item 7).
buildDynamic EXISTS-in-ADD derived cells seed from computed truth at wiring (foldCollection seeds with fold(readAll())), never a fabricated default.
headE / now / slowHeadE N/A no wire demand; a raw source generator expresses one-shot/first-occurrence trivially.
§1 pure map/filter
fmap (Event/Dynamic/Behavior) EXISTS deriveEvent (project.ts:180-187), deriveCell (project.ts:236-280, error policy per the statefulness line), deriveStream (project.ts:163-170).
fmapMaybe / ffilter / filterLeft / filterRight ADD-DEFER SKIP-returning map on deriveEvent ONLY. Illegal on streams: dropping the first frame breaks snapshot-then-delta reconnect (define.ts:58-63); a “filtered stream” is a cell/scan holding the last passing value (scanCell).
ffor/ffor2/ffor3 N/A argument-order sugar.
splitE / Unzip composition two derived members off one upstream; the source bus multicasts.
Event Alt/Apply/Bind/Semigroup/Align/Zip N/A defined by same-frame simultaneity — see the cross-channel argument.
cheap variants (fmapCheap…) N/A Haskell pull-graph perf contract; no analog.
traceEvent / traceDyn EXISTS the onWrite fire-and-forget seam on cells (server.ts ~1110) or a logging map.
§2 sampling (Behavior×Event)
tag/attach/attachWith/<@>/<@ ADD-DEFER server / N/A wire / EXISTS client same-process: a derivation’s compute may read sibling stores synchronously at its publish tick — generalized as combineCells (deferred). Cross-surface over the wire: N/A (no shared frame). Client-side pairing: the UI’s reactive batch.
gate ADD-DEFER gateEvent: drop upstream frames while a sibling cell’s current value fails a predicate; same-process only.
tagPromptlyDyn family vs tag (current d) N/A distinction folds always see the post-write value (store.set precedes bus.publish, server.ts:198-207) — uniformly “promptly”; per-member channels share no frame, so no same-frame old/new distinction exists to spell. Cycle safety is the boot cycle rule + equals-gated fixpoint termination (boot checks above).
§3 fan-in
merge/mergeWith/leftmost/mergeList ADD-DEFER mergeSources — interleave N upstreams into one event member. No cross-channel simultaneity ⇒ the three conflict policies are vacuously one combinator.
mergeMap / mergeInt / mergeIntIncremental EXISTS the deltas coalescer: N same-tick keyed mutations publish ONE upserts/removes frame (createTickCoalescer, server.ts:281-312); tick = microtask.
alignEventWithMaybe / difference N/A simultaneity-defined.
mergeIncremental / mergeMapIncremental(WithMove) ADD-DEFER the collection-member face of the keyed-family core (collectionFromFamily).
unsafeMapIncremental ADD-DEFER deriveCollection — patch-preserving per-key map; hard dependency on CollectionSpec.equals (phase 1) for its reconnect diff.
§4 fan-out
fan / fanMap / EventSelector / selectG EXISTS collection per-key get over perKeyBus (server.ts:382-417): key in, per-key stream out; absent key = held-open subscription.
fanEither / fanThese composition (deferred) two SKIP-filtered derived events off one upstream — needs the filter ADD.
filterEventKey / factorEvent N/A the key travels as data and the client re-subscribes; stop-permanently semantics have no demand.
fanInt / EventSelectorInt N/A perf specialization of fan.
§5 hold-class (stateful)
hold/holdDyn ADD-SHIP observableSource (+ deriveCell) and pollSource (the cell twin of the stream read/install shape; no isEqual — dedup at the target cell’s spec equals).
Accumulator (accum*), foldDyn/foldDynMaybe* ADD-SHIP scanCell — (state, frame) => state fold into a cell; accumMaybe’s “Nothing = no update” = return the previous state reference. Demand: drishti’s committed alerts scan (paired-PR campaign) + deriveCell/scanStream implemented on its loop; the padi activityFeed adoption is conditional (open question 5).
mapAccumDyn/mapAccumB (state + output, snapshot-worthy) ADD-SHIP scanStream — carried state + per-frame delta, wire face snapshot(state)-then-deltas via subscribeBeforeSnapshot (server.ts:350-363).
mapAccum_ family / numberOccurrences* / zipListWithEvent N/A → raw source the state-discarded variants output an Event with no snapshot obligation — neither scanStream (imposes a snapshot face) nor scanCell (produces a cell) fits; the honest analog is a raw source generator closing over carried state (project.ts:172-179). No named combinator until demand names one.
accumIncremental (fold to a PATCH) ADD-DEFER scanCollection — fold emitting collection patches instead of full refolds. Trigger: a foldCollection measured too hot at full refold (urgency today is a deliberate, cheap full refold, urgency.ts:23-38).
scanDyn/scanDynMaybe/mapDynM ADD-SHIP scanCell with a cell upstream (its get iterable, or observableSource on its bus).
count/toggle N/A named one-line scanCell instances.
tailE/headTailE/takeWhileE/…/improvingMaybe N/A prefix/suffix machines; a raw source generator; no in-repo demand.
§6 switching (higher-order)
switch/switchHold*/switcher/switchDyn/switchPromptlyDyn/coincidence/coincidencePatch* N/A on the wire the switching argument above; the index travels as data, the client re-subscribes; scopedByEntry (scoped.ts:81-210) is the client-side switching machinery.
join (Dynamic-is-a-Monad, unkeyed) N/A wire a cell-of-cell is unspellable as wire data (the inner cell would travel as a channel capability); the outer value is data, the client re-subscribes. Keyed joinDynThroughMap is the collection row (§8).
maybeDyn/eitherDyn/factorDyn N/A wire client-side discriminated rendering: a memo on the discriminant; Solid <Show>/<Switch>.
§7 uniqueness
holdUniqDyn / holdUniqDynBy EXISTS producer-side spec equals (define.ts:124), enforced on both write paths (server.ts:198-207, 1469-1474). THIS is where equals lives: at the ONE writer’s publish gate, never inside a deriver, never at a mirror.
UniqDynamic + ptr-equality N/A explicit, reviewable predicate on the spec; JS has no WHNF/ptr semantics to exploit.
alreadyUniqDynamic EXISTS the per-write force equals bypass (server.ts:1238) for re-serve rebind epochs.
stream uniqueness EXISTS (poll shape) pollOnEvent’s isEqual yield gate (server.ts:540-561, gate at :557) — streams have no spec-equals gate, so the source owns it; cells do, which is why pollSource carries none.
collection VALUE uniqueness ADD-SHIP CollectionSpec.equals gating per-key publish + coalescer enqueue (server.ts:1585-1600), mirroring the cell gate. Live demand: drishti’s processChanged (agent main.ts:90-106) is this predicate, hand-held at the write site today. Ships with pollCollection, whose diff is defined in terms of it.
demux N/A wire selection is client state; demuxed(k) = a client memo.

zipDyn / zipDynWith ADD-DEFER server / N/A cross-surface / EXISTS client server-side combineCells, recompute coalesced per microtask tick on its OWN flush. Cross-surface wire zip deliberately absent: independent channels can present (new a, old b); no transactional frame restores glitch-freedom.
distributeMapOverDynPure / joinDynThroughMap / distributeList* EXISTS the collection IS the distributed map: deltas = a coherent whole-map view per tick; keys+get = the per-key view.
splitDynPure composition two derived cells off one upstream.
constDyn / unsafeDynamic EXISTS cell default with no writer / the raw-source escape hatch.
HList machinery / collectDynPure N/A TS structural records; n-ary combineCells, deferred with it.
Num/IsString/Semigroup instances N/A sugar over fmap/zip.
§10 Adjustable + collection UIs
Adjustable/runWithReplace/traverse*WithAdjust(WithMove) EXISTS client / ADD-SHIP server client: scopedByEntry (scoped.ts:81-210). Server: the keyed-family core ships as registryFromFamily (the MapRegistry face its one live consumer feeds); collectionFromFamily deferred.
listHoldWithKey/listWithKey/…/simpleList same scopedByEntry / watchByEntry (client); registryFromFamily → collectionFromFamily (server).
networkView/networkHold/untilReady N/A whole-graph replacement is a process/UI concern: Solid <Show>/Suspense client-side; server-side, the re-serve rebind epoch (force republish, server.ts:1238).

Query/crop/QueryMorphism/SelectedCount/MonadQuery/queryDyn N/A as API per-member subscription + AbortSignal IS a query declaration; subscriber counts are SelectedCount; abort is the decrement-to-zero prune. deprecated inventory N/A aliases of covered combinators.

Open questions

  1. Typed sibling references. foldCollection/combineCells/gateEvent/scanCollection name siblings by string key, boot-checked (existence + verbs + cycles). Compile-time from means threading keyof through the deps builder — the second type materialization projectSurface avoids for TS union-budget reasons (project.ts:288-290, 62-72). Is boot-time throw enough, or is a keyof-only generic affordable?
  2. The tick — refold suppression. foldCollection owns its flush. With CollectionSpec.equals in phase 1, should a flush in which every same-tick upsert was equals-suppressed skip the refold entirely, or is one spec-equals-gated cell publish per armed tick cheap enough? Measure on the ~150ms composed-terminals firehose before adding the skip.
  3. scanCell durability — migration. The signature is fixed (store param; seed from store.get()); the remaining question is version skew: a persisted S whose shape changed across a deploy. Does the initial(stored) function form (caller-owned migration/validation, fail-fast on unparseable) suffice, or do persisted scans need a declared versioned-migration seam?
  4. The registryFromFamily wrapper’s home. The combinator deletes serveHostMap’s cache/fire/reconcile and drishti’s clone; causeFor enrichment (serveHostMap.ts:109-113), the #1716 belt (:259-265), and offsetOf injection (:40-44, 85-95) compose into resolve. Does the composed wrapper stay in surface-remote (shared with drishti), or does drishti import only the projection? Either kills the clone; the package boundary needs an electricity-test ruling.
  5. The activityFeed restructure. scanCell subsumes padi’s activityFeed only if trackRecentRepo/trackRecentAgent become emitter publishes — is that churn worth it now, or does it wait, with only the read-path back-write (activity.ts:50-57, a mutating read) fixed immediately?
  6. The metadata write-seam collapse. The connect seam ships with pollCollection regardless. Does padi’s registry expose the one onChange that collapses the five publishComposedTerminal seams, or does that path keep its convention with only the urgency rider deleted?
  7. Fail-fast — visibility of a stopped stateful pump. The doctrine line is ruled (sync in-tick = crash; async stateless = log-skip-continue; async stateful = log-stop-hold). Remaining: should a stopped stateful pump escalate beyond stderr — e.g. flip the liveness gate (define.ts:143) so the freeze is visible on health() — given the history with frozen-but-live-looking members (#1034)?
  8. Cross-surface zip. Hard-rule it client-side forever (no transactional frame on the wire), or leave the deferred combineCells open to a cross-surface variant with documented eventual consistency if demand ever names one?
  9. scanMsgSchema vs collectionDeltasSchema. Unify ScanMsg with CollectionDeltasMsg (a keyed scan is a collection; an unkeyed one isn’t) or keep distinct authorities? Unifying lets scanStream consumers reuse the collection client fold; it also blurs “collection = keyed, patchable” (define.ts:75-87) for a member with no keys.
  10. The cycle rule’s reach. The boot cycle check covers only from-declared edges; scanCell over an arbitrary upstream iterable is invisible to it. Is “equals-gated fixpoint termination + a documented livelock-is-a-bug rule” enough for the free-form subset, or should scanCell-over-a-sibling-cell get a declarative from spelling so its edge joins the checked graph?
  11. pollCollection cadence composition. install owns the cadence (interval, event, or both — drishti wants interval + immediate first tick; kolu’s samplers want event-triggered resample). Is one install seam enough, or do interval-and-event-fused cadences deserve a tiny shared helper so each caller doesn’t re-spell “setInterval + onState + fire now”?
